## ShAnalyzeResourceError class

An observed host resource failure prevented an analysis operation from completing. This reports the failing operation rather than imposing a fixed syntax-depth budget. The original stack-exhaustion error remains the standard cause; no partial observation or successful empty result is supplied. Unrelated host failures retain their own identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class ShAnalyzeResourceError extends ShAnalysisError
```

**Extends:** [ShAnalysisError](./sh-analysis.shanalysiserror.md)
